plan.title: Coordinated Emergency Response Plan - Ward 18 Extreme Rainfall & Inundation
plan.operatorNote: Approved for immediate multi-department dispatch by Zone Counselor.

actions.recommendation: Bypass Route R7 and reroute Unit 108-B4 via Canal North, which Citizen reports confirm is clear (0 flood reports) and Historical Memory shows achieved zero STEMI mortality.
actions.reason: Unit 108-B4 with a STEMI patient has 14 minutes remaining in the critical window but faces a 31-minute ETA while stationary for 9 minutes 740 m from Ward 18 ER. Traffic agent recommends diverting via Route R7, which explicitly conflicts with Citizen reports showing knee-to-waist inundation and 6 stalled vehicles on the R7 on-ramp.
actions.expectedImpact: Mitigate STEMI Patient Window Breach Due to Traffic Gridlock and Flooded Diversion Route

actions.recommendation: Cancel R7 diversion, activate signal override at junctions J14 and J17 to direct traffic toward Canal North, and alert transit units of R7 on-ramp stalls.
actions.reason: Traffic agent recommends diverting Hospital Road congestion (93% congestion, 4 km/hr) onto Route R7, which explicitly conflicts with Water agent data showing R7 outfall depth at 138 cm (exceeding 120 cm design max) and Citizen reports of 6 stalled vehicles. Injecting traffic onto R7 will trap 3 blocked emergency units and repeat the 2023 failure where R7 failed in 19 minutes.
actions.expectedImpact: Mitigate Compounding Gridlock via Misrouted Traffic onto Inundated Outfall Drain Network

actions.recommendation: Dispatch manual field crew immediately to actuate Canal North gate 4N within 22 minutes to reduce primary sump utilization.
actions.reason: Weather agent reports a stationary convective cell delivering 118 mm/hr rainfall (exceeding 45 mm/hr drain capacity) for 40 minutes. This will cause Water agent's primary sump (96% utilization) to overflow in 22 minutes due to 138 cm outfall depth back-pressure, requiring manual actuation of Canal North gate 4N which Memory agent notes reduced historical sump level by 34% in 15 minutes.
actions.expectedImpact: Mitigate Primary Sump Overflow and Drainage Back-Pressure Escalation

conflictsResolved.cost: rejected R7, adopted R9 (+1 min transit cost)

plan.gateReason: Confidence 70/100 — within range but not high enough, or not low-cost enough, for auto-execution.
